name: 65 - API - Import Clinic Knowledge Source - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT $1::TEXT action,$2::TEXT clinic_name,NULLIF($3::BIGINT,0) document_id,
         NULLIF($4::TEXT,'') title,$5::TEXT source_type,NULLIF($6::TEXT,'') original_filename,
         NULLIF($7::TEXT,'') mime_type,$8::TEXT specialty,NULLIF($9::TEXT,'') topic,
         NULLIF($10::TEXT,'') service_name,$11::TEXT version_label,$12::INTEGER source_priority,
         $13::TEXT allowed_use,NULLIF($14::TEXT,'') raw_text,$15::JSONB qa_items,
         $16::JSONB response_policy,$17::JSONB metadata,NULLIF($18::TEXT,'') approved_by
),
c AS (
  SELECT clinics.id clinic_id,clinics.name clinic_name,r.*
  FROM clinics,r WHERE clinics.name=r.clinic_name AND clinics.is_active=TRUE LIMIT 1
),
s AS (
  SELECT services.id service_id,services.name service_name
  FROM services,c WHERE services.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
    AND LOWER(services.name)=LOWER(c.service_name)
    AND c.service_name IS NOT NULL AND services.is_active=TRUE LIMIT 1
),
created AS (
  INSERT INTO clinic_knowledge_documents (
    clinic_id,service_id,title,source_type,original_filename,mime_type,specialty,topic,
    version_label,status,source_priority,raw_text,content_hash,allowed_use,response_policy,metadata
  )
  SELECT c.clinic_id,(SELECT service_id FROM s),c.title,
         CASE WHEN c.action='create_qa_document' THEN 'qa' ELSE c.source_type END,
         c.original_filename,c.mime_type,c.specialty,c.topic,c.version_label,
         CASE WHEN c.action='create_qa_document' THEN 'review' ELSE 'draft' END,
         c.source_priority,c.raw_text,MD5(COALESCE(c.raw_text,c.qa_items::TEXT)),
         c.allowed_use,c.response_policy,c.metadata
  FROM c
  WHERE c.action IN ('create_text_document','create_qa_document')
    AND (c.service_name IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s))
  RETURNING *
),
job AS (
  INSERT INTO clinic_knowledge_ingestion_jobs(document_id,status)
  SELECT id,'pending' FROM created WHERE source_type<>'qa'
  ON CONFLICT(document_id) DO UPDATE SET status='pending',updated_at=NOW()
  RETURNING *
),
qa_rows AS (
  SELECT d.id document_id,d.clinic_id,d.service_id,d.specialty,d.topic,d.source_priority,i
  FROM created d CROSS JOIN c CROSS JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(c.qa_items) i
  WHERE d.source_type='qa'
),
qa_inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO clinic_knowledge_qa (
    clinic_id,document_id,service_id,specialty,topic,question,answer,
    question_variants,keywords,requires_human_confirmation,safety_category,
    source_priority,status
  )
  SELECT q.clinic_id,q.document_id,q.service_id,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(q.i->>'specialty',''),q.specialty),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(q.i->>'topic',''),q.topic),
         q.i->>'question',q.i->>'answer',
         COALESCE(q.i->'question_variants','[]'::JSONB),
         COALESCE(q.i->'keywords','[]'::JSONB),
         COALESCE((q.i->>'requires_human_confirmation')::BOOLEAN,FALSE),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(q.i->>'safety_category',''),'general'),
         COALESCE((q.i->>'source_priority')::INTEGER,q.source_priority),'draft'
  FROM qa_rows q
  WHERE NULLIF(q.i->>'question','') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(q.i->>'answer','') IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING *
),
published AS (
  UPDATE clinic_knowledge_documents d
  SET status='published',approved_by=c.approved_by,approved_at=NOW(),updated_at=NOW()
  FROM c
  WHERE c.action='publish' AND d.id=c.document_id AND d.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
    AND ((d.source_type='qa' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_knowledge_qa q WHERE q.document_id=d.id))
      OR (d.source_type<>'qa' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinic_knowledge_chunks k WHERE k.document_id=d.id)))
  RETURNING d.*
),
published_qa AS (
  UPDATE clinic_knowledge_qa q
  SET status='published',approved_by=c.approved_by,approved_at=NOW(),updated_at=NOW()
  FROM c,published d WHERE q.document_id=d.id RETURNING q.id
),
archived AS (
  UPDATE clinic_knowledge_documents d
  SET status='archived',updated_at=NOW()
  FROM c WHERE c.action='archive' AND d.id=c.document_id AND d.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
  RETURNING d.*
),
archived_qa AS (
  UPDATE clinic_knowledge_qa q SET status='archived',updated_at=NOW()
  FROM archived d WHERE q.document_id=d.id RETURNING q.id
),
listed AS (
  SELECT d.id,d.title,d.source_type,d.original_filename,d.specialty,d.topic,
         s2.name service_name,d.version_label,d.status,d.source_priority,d.allowed_use,
         d.approved_by,d.approved_at,d.created_at,d.updated_at,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinic_knowledge_chunks k WHERE k.document_id=d.id) chunk_count,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinic_knowledge_qa q WHERE q.document_id=d.id) qa_count
  FROM clinic_knowledge_documents d JOIN c ON c.clinic_id=d.clinic_id
  LEFT JOIN services s2 ON s2.id=d.service_id
  WHERE c.action='list'
  ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC,d.id DESC LIMIT 500
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c) THEN FALSE
    WHEN r.service_name IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s)
      AND r.action IN ('create_text_document','create_qa_document') THEN FALSE
    WHEN r.action IN ('create_text_document','create_qa_document') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM created) THEN FALSE
    WHEN r.action='publish' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM published) THEN FALSE
    WHEN r.action='archive' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM archived) THEN FALSE
    ELSE TRUE
  END success,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c) THEN 'clinic_not_found'
    WHEN r.service_name IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s) THEN 'service_not_found'
    WHEN r.action='create_text_document' THEN 'knowledge_document_created'
    WHEN r.action='create_qa_document' THEN 'knowledge_qa_document_created'
    WHEN r.action='publish' THEN 'knowledge_document_published'
    WHEN r.action='archive' THEN 'knowledge_document_archived'
    ELSE 'knowledge_documents_listed'
  END result,
  COALESCE((SELECT id FROM created),(SELECT id FROM published),(SELECT id FROM archived)) document_id,
  (SELECT id FROM job) ingestion_job_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa_inserted),0) qa_items_created,
  COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(listed)) FROM listed),'[]'::JSONB) documents,
  CASE r.action
    WHEN 'create_text_document' THEN 'chunk_and_index_document'
    WHEN 'create_qa_document' THEN 'review_and_publish_document'
    WHEN 'publish' THEN 'available_for_rag'
    ELSE 'none'
  END next_action
FROM r;

parameters.content:
## ورود سند یا Q&A

متن PDF/Word پس از استخراج در raw_text قرار می‌گیرد.

فقط منابع published وارد RAG می‌شوند.
